title: Refer-a-Neighbor Rules for Residential Electricity Supply
content:
Program rules, Residential Electricity Supply. A customer who refers a friend or neighbour is the referring customer; the new customer who names the referring customer's customer number at enrollment is the referred customer.

## Rules in force

1. **Qualification.** A referral qualifies when the referred customer's power agreement, which names the referring customer as its referrer, reaches the plan's qualifying number of completed cycles. An agreement's completed cycles are the number of distinct billing cycles, by billing period start, among its energy charge lines whose billing period ended on or before the handling date, counted from its service start date; the on-peak and off-peak lines of one cycle count once.
2. **Active referrer.** When the plan requires an active referrer and the referring customer has no active power agreement, no credit is posted.
3. **One credit per referred customer.** Each referred customer earns the referrer one referral credit only; once a referral credit line names that referred customer, no second one is posted for them.
4. **Annual limit.** A referring customer receives no more than the plan's maximum number of referral credits in a calendar year. The count is the referral credit lines posted in the calendar year (January 1 through December 31) containing the posting date being considered, across all of the referring customer's Residential Electricity Supply agreements. Referrals beyond the limit earn nothing and are not carried into the next year.
5. **Referred customer.** The referred customer receives no referral credit.

## Retired clause

The former clause "The referral credit is posted on the referring customer's earliest-enrolled power agreement that is active on the posting date, at that agreement's referral credit, with the referred customer named on the line." is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for where a referral credit is posted and its amount.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical referrers, using the 10-credit annual limit and 2 qualifying cycles every plan carries)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Referred agreement has 1 completed cycle | Not yet qualified |
| Referred agreement has 2 completed cycles; referrer has an active agreement | Qualifies for one referral credit |
| Referrer's only agreement is closed | No credit |
| Referrer already has 10 referral credits posted this calendar year | No credit; not carried into next year |
| A referral credit already names this referred customer | No second credit |

superseded_clauses: The referral credit is posted on the referring customer's earliest-enrolled power agreement that is active on the posting date, at that agreement's referral_credit_usd, with referred_customer_id set to the referred customer.
